stories.explanation: Launch progression of the fifth-generation da Vinci 5 surgical system.
stories.signal: Successful launch of da Vinci 5 system marks a major technological advancement in robotic-assisted surgery.
stories.description: The da Vinci 5 system represents the fifth-generation robotic surgical platform, designed to enhance surgical capabilities and improve the operating experience for surgeons.
_validation: Verified da Vinci 5 FDA clearance March 2024 from 10-K: 'In March 2024, we obtained FDA clearance for our da Vinci 5 surgical system'
Verified international regulatory clearances: South Korea (October 2024), Japan (June 2025), EU (July 2025)
Verified installed base: 'As of December 31, 2025, we have an installed base of 1,231 da Vinci 5 surgical systems'
Confirmed phased international launch ongoing as of 2025

stories.explanation: Progression of adoption of the da Vinci SP system, designed for single-incision surgery.
stories.signal: Continued growth in da Vinci SP adoption demonstrates acceptance of single-port minimally invasive surgical approach.
stories.description: The da Vinci SP system is a robotic-assisted surgical platform enabling surgeons to operate through a single incision, offering potential benefits for patient recovery compared to multi-port approaches.
_validation: Verified da Vinci SP installed base of 377 from 10-K: 'we have an installed base of 377 da Vinci SP surgical systems as of December 31, 2025'
Verified da Vinci SP commercialized in 2018
Confirmed early launch stage as of 2025 with measured rollout strategy in Europe (commercialization began January 2024)
